title: The Ancient End
description: Have you ever wondered if The End was once home to an... Ancestral Civilization?
body:
🌌 The Ancient End

Have you ever wondered if The End was once home to an... Ancestral Civilization? Thousands of years later, the ancient ruins and spirits of that era still linger in the void. The Ancient End lets you bridge that gap, uncovering technology so advanced it feels like magic (but let’s be honest, it’s actually just really shiny purple rocks).

Here’s what you’ll find in this legendary journey:

🛡️ Ancient Ender Armor: Elite Gear

This is the gear used by the ancient gods of the End.

DASH Ability: Equip the full set and double-tap "Space"... BAM! You’ll propel forward like you’ve been shot out of a cannon.

Ancestral Respect: Wearing even one piece makes Endermans respect you enough to not attack when you look at them. Finally, you can stand there and appreciate those beautiful purple eyes without them trying to delete your save file.

💜 The Ancient Enderman: Your New Best Friend (Literally)

Who said Endermans can’t be friend? These guys had a deep bond with humans back in the day.

Void Rescue: If you’re exploring the End and accidentally fall... don't panic! Your tamed Enderman will teleport and bring you back to safety.

Loyalty Until the End: He’ll fight by your side, but watch out: if you fall into the void while he’s following you, he will sacrifice himself and die with you. A tragic, poetic, and very sad ending for your inventory. (PS: He is not lava-proof, don't abuse his faith).

🐎 Ancient Ender Horse: Breaking Newton's Laws

The only ride that doesn't care about the laws of physics.

Passive Powers: Tame it with an Ancient Eye to get permanent Night Vision and Zero Fall Damage.

Lava Walker: It can walk on lava. Perfect for strolling through the Nether like it’s a Sunday walk in the park.

💎 Resources & Tools: The Building Blocks of Power

Ancient Ender Pearl: This isn't just a "throw-and-hope-for-the-best" pearl. It’s the pure essence of the End, essential for forging all your ancestral gear.

Ancient Ender Eye: The "Swiss Army Knife" of the mod. Use them to tame and heal your horse or as the core of your Enderman's spawn egg. Crafted like a normal Eye (with Blaze Powder), but using the Ancient Pearl.

The Egg Recipe: Head to the crafting table and place an Ancient Eye in the center, then surround it with Ancient Pearls in a cross pattern (+). It’s like a secret handshake, but with more purple glitter.

Ancestral Tools: Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, and Shovel. Forged from the very soul of the dimension, they are faster and stronger than anything you’ve used before.

Developed by NicoDelux22.
